'''Enneth Holkin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

His criminal record consisted of stealing a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|bike]] for a joyride when he was a teenager on Corellia. Later, he would become aide to Co-[[Chief of State (Corellia)|Chief of State]] of Corellia [[Denjax Teppler]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. Holkin was on his way to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], who was suffering from a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]], suddenly ambushed him and knocked him out, taking his clothes so he could get into Level 2 of the Senate Building; an area which Horn was not authorized to access, but Holkin was.
